newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Mayr-Melnhof sees group H1 97 net up on 96.
newsitem.headline: Mayr-Melnhof sees group H1 97 net up on 96.

text.p: Austrian cardboard maker Mayr-Melnhof said on Wednesday it expected net profit in the first half of 1997 to be above the first half figure last year of 243 million schillings.
"...The preliminary profit after tax surpasses the good results of the first half-year 1996 and sales will be slightly higher than in 1996," the company said in a statement.
The company said it expected full capacity utilisation in the summer months due to high order backlog in the Cardboard Division. Its Packaging Division had also recorded high order intakes, it noted.
However, Mayr-Melnhof predicted limited improvements in sales in its Recycling Division.
"Despite satisfactory sales, the situation of the Recycling Division remains strained due to the adverse price situation," it said.
